name: Ground-edge stone tools
summary: A basalt flake with an abraded bevel is interpreted as removal from a ground-edge axe, documenting a method for making and resharpening cutting edges.

name: Adaptive artificial neural-network learning
summary: Adjusting parameters in an artificial network from examples or feedback to perform a task.

name: Ammonia compression refrigeration
summary: Mechanical refrigeration that uses ammonia as the working fluid in a vapor-compression cycle.

name: Apochromatic microscope objective
summary: A microscope objective corrected so that three colours of light come to a common focus, greatly reducing colour fringing.

name: Aquaculture
summary: Raising and managing fish or other aquatic animals in enclosed or controlled waters.

name: Aqueduct
summary: A built channel that carries water by gravity over long distances to supply a settlement or works.

name: Atmospheric steam engine

name: Boat mill

name: Compound steam engine

name: Consumer cooperative

name: Copper smelting

name: Crewed Earth orbit

name: Dairy curd straining

name: Debt collection agency

name: Discrete inheritance patterns

name: DNA sequencing

name: Double-entry bookkeeping

name: Artificial Earth satellite

name: Electric motor

name: Electric rail traction

name: Electromagnetic induction
summary: The production of an electric current in a circuit by a changing magnetic field.

name: Figurative scene-making

name: Froth flotation

name: Gas-turbine jet aircraft

name: Hafir

name: Hot blast

name: Infinitesimal calculus

name: Integrated circuit

name: Raised-floor food storage
